mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-6913, -735.6) and has to end up at (-24827, -11408). On the way it must stop at A (Winthrop University Hospital Heliport) at (25788, 2424), B (Metropolitan Electric Heliport) at (-18018, 18603), C (Hoffmann-La Roche Inc Heliport) at (-17074, 12765), D (American Cyanamid Linden Heliport) at (-21035, -13332); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [LaGuardia Airport (KLGA, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [John F. Kennedy International Airport (KJFK, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [Teterboro Airport (KTEB, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [Newark Liberty International Airport (KEWR, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 132792 meters. The battery only allows 139054 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Paulus Hook Pier Heliport; DEST is Linden Airport.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
